name: Grangehill
agent: Marcella Savage, Sherry FitzGerald McCreery, Kilkenny
questions: The certificate is quoted as B3, but MyHome gives an EPI of 121 kWh/m²/yr, which is in the B2 band. Which is right, and can you send the BER advisory report (oil boiler age, insulation, windows)?
When were the well water last tested and the septic tank last desludged or inspected? Is the tank's percolation area in the front or rear lawn?
Can you send the folio map? Is the boundary dog-proof all round, especially the post-and-rail fence on the north-east side and the wooded strip along the farm track to the east?
What size is the detached workshop, does it have power, and is it covered by planning permission?
Who uses the farm track along the north-east boundary, and are any of the 8 planning applications BuyerIQ shows within 1 km for the fields beside the house?

ai.why: A solid fit: 271 m², a ground-floor double with its own en-suite plus a ground-floor family bathroom for the parents, four bathrooms, B3, and Kilkenny's strong schools, ED and station 10 minutes away. Held back by 0.6 ac rather than an acre, a neighbour's house close on the west side, a private well and septic tank, and a price a little over the line.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; not stated, but the house is lived in.

water.detail: Private well, stated in the listing's features. Ask for a recent water test.

sewer.detail: Septic tank, stated in the listing's features. Ask its condition and when it was last desludged.

internet.detail: Full fibre likely: BuyerIQ lists 'Fast broadband — 390 Mb full fibre' for this address, though the speed detail is behind its paywall; the listing says nothing. Check the Eircode with NBI and open eir.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Bedroom 1 (4.0 × 4.0 m, fitted wardrobe) is on the ground floor with its own en-suite shower room, and Bedroom 2 (4.12 × 4.10 m) sits beside the ground-floor family bathroom (bath and separate shower); confirmed on the floor plan.

bedsNote: Two doubles on the ground floor (one en-suite); three upstairs, including the master with en-suite and dressing room and Bedroom 3 with en-suite
heating: Oil-fired central heating, with multi-fuel stoves in the kitchen and sitting room
tagline: A 2007 stone-faced five-bed, four-bath dormer house of 271 m² with two ground-floor bedrooms on 0.6 acres in the countryside east of Kilkenny city, about 10 minutes from town.

pros.detail: Bedroom 1 (4.0 × 4.0 m) has its own en-suite shower room and a fitted wardrobe; Bedroom 2 (4.12 × 4.10 m) is next to a 2.70 × 3.48 m family bathroom with a bath and separate shower, all on one hall off the living rooms.

pros.text: Room for six: 271 m², five doubles, four bathrooms
pros.detail: Two en-suites upstairs (the master with a dressing room, Bedroom 3 at 4.41 × 5.96 m), a 7.6 m upper hall, a 6.0 × 3.2 m living/dining room, a 3.58 × 5.95 m sitting room and a separate utility.
About 10.4 km by the listing: St Kieran's and Kilkenny College (both rated strong), St Luke's 24-hour ED that takes children, the MacDonagh station and the city's supermarkets and restaurants.
Stone-faced with granite sills, BER B3 (EPI 121 kWh/m²/yr); the photos show a clean, lived-in interior with timber floors and a handmade-style kitchen, not a renovation job.

pros.text: Open fields to the north and east, countryside views
pros.detail: The aerials show tillage and grazing beyond a farm track on two sides and long views south over rolling country; the lane in front is a quiet local road.
St Colman's NS, Clara (co-ed, 204 pupils, not DEIS) is 1.9 km; M9 exit 7 at Paulstown, with an Applegreen and M&S Food, is about 7 minutes.
A big shed at the back of the plot with double-gated side access for vehicles; useful for storage, a workshop or dog kit.

cons.detail: €25k over budget; about €1,937/m², stamp duty about €5,250. On the market since 24 Sep 2026 (32 days, about 4,300 views) with no price change; a nearby Templemartin, Clara house sold for €605k in Dec 2025.

cons.text: 0.6 acres, much of it not lawn
cons.detail: 0.24 ha on a triangular plot; the site map shows a wooded strip along the eastern side, the workshop at the back and a gravel yard, so the open lawn for the dogs is perhaps a third of an acre (rough, by eye).

cons.text: A neighbour's house close on the west side
cons.detail: The aerial shows a large house and yard roughly 20–30 m from the west gable, with a cluster of four or five houses along the lane; space around the house is open only to the north and east.

cons.text: Private well, septic tank and oil
cons.detail: All stated in the listing; the well water and the tank need checking, and oil heating will need replacing in time.

cons.text: Six trains a day from Kilkenny
cons.detail: Kilkenny MacDonagh is about 11 km; the current timetable shows 6 weekday departures to Heuston (first 07:28, arriving 09:00), about 1h30–1h37.
Stone wall and timber fencing at the front; the rear post-and-rail fence is partly broken and the eastern strip is open woodland along a farm track.

'Exceptional potential' in the listing: the inside is sound but dated in places (travertine-effect bathrooms, laminate upstairs), the rendered rear walls are stained and the workshop is weathered; rough €10–25k to freshen.

cons.text: BER figure doesn't match the letter
cons.detail: Quoted as B3, but the published EPI of 121 kWh/m²/yr falls in the B2 band (100–125); ask for the certificate.

trips.label: School run
trips.title: St Colman's National School, Clara
candidates: St Colman's National School, Clara, Co. Kilkenny R95 YW73
Clara National School, Clara, Co. Kilkenny
trips.note: Co-ed Catholic vertical school (juniors to 6th), roll 16116I, 204 pupils (94 boys) in 2025/26, not DEIS, with an autism class; 1.9 km per the listing.

rating.basis: Co-ed, not DEIS, enrolment steady (down 5% since 2019/20); no inspection report could be retrieved.

walk.note: Quiet narrow lanes between hedges for ~1.9 km, then a village road with a footpath to St. Colman's; no verges, so kids walk single file.

bike.note: Quiet single-track lanes almost the whole way; a nice ride for kids with an adult.

trips.title: St Kieran's College

trips.note: St Kieran's (boys, non-fee-paying) about 8.8 km; Kilkenny College (mixed, fee-paying) about 8.2 km. The nearer Presentation and Loreto are girls-only.

rating.basis: St Kieran's had 100% progression to third level in the 2023 feeder-school report (Kilkenny People/Irish Independent); Kilkenny College was reported at over 100% (KCLR, 2016 tables).
